stage.note: No funding announcements, accelerator participation, investor pages, or Crunchbase/press coverage found; site, blog, ToS and HN mentions describe a small, self-run Estonian hosting company (OakHost OÜ, reg. no. 16131052) with no mention of external investment. Classified bootstrapped by absence of any raise evidence rather than a confirmed statement to that effect; could also simply be unknown.

note: OakHost OÜ is a small, privately-registered Estonian company (Magdaleena 15, 11312 Tallinn, reg. no. 16131052 per its ToS) offering dedicated Mac mini hosting from a German data center. No evidence of VC funding, accelerator participation, or public financials was found; it presents as an independently owned, bootstrapped niche hosting business. All 11 dedicated Mac configurations plus the one-week trial were shown out of stock/unavailable on oakhost.com as of 2026-09-28, which is a buyer-relevant availability concern separate from the funding question.
